265:t_1:83.en:
$$ランド$$
「Here, I brought beer. Let's have a drink after dinner.」

265:t_1:84.en:
$$赤木$$
「Thanks, $$ランド$$. Beer with a view of the galaxy isn't bad at all.」

265:t_1:85.en:
$$青山$$
「How about you, $$シモン$$? Are you excited to be in the middle of the galaxy, too?」

265:t_1:86.en:
$$シモン$$
「Of course I am. Ever since we left underground $$ジーハ村$$, we've kept moving up and up.」

265:t_1:87.en:
$$シモン$$
「Now that we're here, I want to punch right through the galaxy's center with my drill.」

265:t_1:88.en:
$$青山$$
「Hey, now... We're moving away from the center, not toward it, remember?」

265:t_1:90.en:
$$ランド$$
「But you fought that 《$$アンチスパイラル$$》 everyone's talking about somewhere beyond this galaxy, right?」

265:t_1:91.en:
$$シモン$$
「I was so desperate to get $$ニア$$ back, I didn't have time to look around until I'd beaten him.」

265:t_1:92.en:
$$シモン$$
「Standing in the middle of the galaxy like this makes me realize how tiny I am...」

265:t_1:93.en:
$$シモン$$
「At the same time, it makes me want to make this whole vast universe my own.」

265:t_1:94.en:
$$赤木$$
「You want to rule the galaxy!?」

265:t_1:95.en:
$$シモン$$
「That's not it... I can't explain it well, but I want to see how far I can go in this vast world.」

265:t_1:96.en:
$$竜馬$$
「I get it, $$シモン$$. But right now...」

265:t_1:97.en:
$$シモン$$
「Yeah... I feel the same as when we fought $$アンチスパイラル$$.」

265:t_1:98.en:
$$シモン$$
「I'm going back to Earth to get $$ニア$$ back from $$サイデリアル$$.」

265:t_1:99.en:
$$青山$$
「Then our practical option is to use their ability to travel through hyperspace over enormous distances.」

265:t_1:100.en:
$$ランド$$
「Why do those bastards show up when nobody calls them, but never at times like this?」

265:t_1:101.en:
$$竜馬$$
「You don't need to worry about that. They aren't going to let us escape anyway.」

265:t_1:103.en:
$$竜馬$$
「No... $$サイデリアル$$ isn't the only one after us. So are the $$宇宙怪獣$$ and $$インベーダー#robot$$s.」

265:t_1:104.en:
$$竜馬$$
「I've got a feeling... A big battle's coming soon...」

265:t_2:6.en:
$$早乙女$$
「I'm glad you look well. Though I never thought this much would make you give up.」

265:t_2:8.en:
$$早乙女$$
「Your foul mouth hasn't changed, either. $$隼人$$ and $$弁慶$$ have grown up somewhat, at least.」

265:t_2:10.en:
$$早乙女$$
「This place transcends time, life and death. Your comrades are probably hearing my voice in their own ways, too.」

265:t_2:11.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Not just $$コーウェン$$ and $$スティンガー$$... Even you've come back to life...!」

265:t_2:12.en:
$$早乙女$$
「Don't misunderstand, $$竜馬$$. They and I already walk different paths.」

265:t_2:14.en:
$$ミチル$$
「I'm sure you can listen calmly to Father's words now.」

265:t_2:15.en:
$$竜馬$$
「$$武蔵$$...! You're here too, $$ミチル$$...!」

265:t_2:17.en:
$$ミチル$$
「It's been a long time, $$竜馬$$.」

265:t_2:19.en:
$$早乙女$$
「You should already know that $$ゲッター線$$ guided you here.」

265:t_2:21.en:
$$渓$$
「What's that supposed to mean, Dad!? And you too, Sis!」

265:t_2:22.en:
$$早乙女$$
「Good grief... Having $$弁慶$$ raise 《$$元気$$》 because the $$インベーダー#robot$$s parasitized me was a mistake after all, perhaps.」

265:t_2:23.en:
$$ミチル$$
「Father... She's $$渓$$ now, not $$元気$$.」

265:t_2:24.en:
$$早乙女$$
「Oh, that's right. ...But she's at that age now. I'd have liked her to be a little more ladylike.」

265:t_2:27.en:
$$早乙女$$
「$$號$$... I must thank you.」

265:t_2:29.en:
$$ミチル$$
「Thank you for protecting $$渓$$ alongside the $$ゲッター線$$ all this time.」

265:t_2:30.en:
$$號$$
「That's my mission... and the reason I was born.」

265:t_2:31.en:
$$弁慶$$
「Give me a break, Doctor, $$武蔵$$. I really did try to raise $$渓$$ to be ladylike.」

265:t_2:32.en:
$$武蔵$$
「The process doesn't matter now! It's the result that counts!」

265:t_2:35.en:
$$早乙女$$
「Thank you, $$弁慶$$. It's thanks to you that $$元気$$... that $$渓$$ grew up so strong.」

265:t_2:37.en:
$$隼人$$
「Heh... I'm the only one who's gotten old, $$ミチル$$.」

265:t_2:38.en:
$$ミチル$$
「But I'm happy I can talk to you now that you've grown up, $$隼人$$.」

265:t_2:40.en:
$$隼人$$
「...But, Doctor. You didn't call us here just for a reunion in the middle of the galaxy, did you?」

265:t_2:41.en:
$$早乙女$$
「Of course not, $$隼人$$. There's something I must tell you.」

265:t_2:43.en:
$$早乙女$$
「It's about the universe's collapse... No, its rebirth.」

265:t_2:45.en:
$$竜馬$$
「...We heard it many times during the $$時獄戦役$$. The universe collapses once every 12,000 years to be reborn.」

265:t_2:47.en:
$$竜馬$$
「And I know $$バアル$$ is born for that purpose. But what do those monsters have to do with the universe's rebirth?」

265:t_2:48.en:
$$早乙女$$
「$$バアル$$ is born to erase the power of life from this universe.」

265:t_2:50.en:
$n
「The enemy often said that... to $$バサラ$$...」

265:t_2:51.en:
$$ミチル$$
「The power of life doesn't refer only to 《$$アニマスピリチア$$》.」

265:t_2:52.en:
$$早乙女$$
「It is something more universal... something every living being possesses.」

265:t_2:53.en:
$n
「Does it mean... the strength to live...?」

265:t_2:54.en:
$$早乙女$$
「It is also the key to drawing out the power governing the natural order of all things... In other words, $$オリジン・ロー$$.」

265:t_2:55.en:
$n
「$$オリジン・ロー$$...!? You mean $$次元力|lc$$!」

265:t_2:56.en:
$n
「The power of life draws out $$次元力|lc$$... It's true the $$スフィア$$s draw out $$次元力|lc$$ through human emotions and hearts, too...」

265:t_2:57.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...I see. And what are you, who know that truth? Will you call yourselves emissaries of God?」

265:t_2:59.en:
$$早乙女$$
「We have entrusted our lives to the flow toward $$シンカ$$.」

265:t_2:60.en:
$$スズネ$$
「So that's it... I'm beginning to understand.」
